channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from morningNewsSection1, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: DHS acknowledges the noncitizen numbers it touted on voter rolls were inflated
item.description: The Trump administration claimed to have found 250,000 noncitizens on voter rolls in four states, but agency communications with states since then indicate the figures were overstated.

item.title: Several states will decide voter ID ballot measures this year
item.description: Voters in at least six states will decide on voter ID ballot measures this year, the most in a single election cycle.

item.title: Country music icon Dolly Parton passes away at age 80
item.description: A celebrated country music star, Parton became one of the genre's most famous and beloved figures worldwide.

item.title: Canada hits back with tariffs as U.S. trade dispute escalates
item.description: Following new U.S. tariffs on Canadian goods and threats of more, Canada announces retaliatory measures.
